month_successor.description: Name the month that comes N (1-3) months after a given month, wrapping mod 12. Control copies the given month name from the same sentence frame.

roman_numeral.description: Convert an Arabic number (1-39) to Roman numerals. Control asks to write the same number back in digits.

ordinal_word.description: Convert a digit 1-12 into its English ordinal word (third, seventh). Control converts the same digit to its cardinal word (three, seven).

weekday_successor.description: Name the weekday N (1-3) days after a given weekday, wrapping mod 7. Control repeats the starting weekday.

color_of_object.description: Name the typical color of a common object (banana -> yellow). Control copies the object noun from the same frame.

greek_letter_successor.description: Continue the Greek alphabet: given two consecutive Greek letter names, give the next. Control repeats the last given letter.

country_of_city.description: Name the country a famous city is in (Paris -> France). Control copies the city name.

en_fr_translation.description: Translate a common English noun into French (first token of the French word). Control: same template, but repeat the English word.
